integrity.finite_checks: Complete direct enumeration in field-size and dimension cases (2,2), (3,2), (4,2), (5,2), (7,2), (2,3); no computational substitute for general proof.
integrity.proof_scope: All prime powers and all matrix dimensions for the orbit transform; all prime powers for two-by-two sharp norm and zero count.

scientific_limitations: The all-dimensional formula gives an exact eigenline balance criterion, not a closed count of zero frequencies for dimensions greater than two.
The simplified sharp endpoint norm and Fourier-zero multiplicity are established only for two-by-two matrix spaces.
Earlier equivalent orbital-transform formulas may exist outside the accessible primary sources; priority is bounded, not exhaustively certified.
title: Cyclotomic Fourier zeros of rank-one idempotents and sharp \(2\times2\) endpoint norms
